title: War in the Mawdeep Sinkholes
changes: The Mawdeep Sinkholes join the clan war: ten sinkholes territories held by the Hide-Kin, whose seat is now Hidehall.
The Sinkway joins the sinkholes to the Oakvale Lands on the war table. Thornwood and the Humpback Mesas are no longer Hide-Kin capitals and can be taken.
The Ossuary Host now holds Stormbreak Crags and the Redfang clan Heronwreck Strand as capitals in the Oakvale Lands.
The Ropewell bounty board now offers war writs for the sinkholes. Ropewell, the Great Maw and the open sinkholes stay out of the war.
